scenes.name: WILL IT DECAY
lines: Will the proton decay? Grand unification puts quarks and leptons in one multiplet.
质子会不会衰变？大统一把夸克与轻子装进同一个多重态。
Then three quark doublets and a lepton doublet can meet at a single point: the operator QQQL.
于是三个夸克双重态与一个轻子双重态可以在同一点相遇：这就是算符 QQQL。
Its hypercharge, three sixths minus one half, is zero. It is gauge invariant, and changes baryon number by one.
它的超荷是三个六分之一减二分之一，恰为零；它规范不变，却让重子数改变一。

scenes.name: THIRTY-SIX TERMS
lines: Maybe three identical quark fields, antisymmetrized, cancel by Pauli exclusion?
也许三个同代夸克场一反对称化，就被泡利不相容消掉了？
Expand it term by term: twelve quark components, four lepton components.
那就逐项展开：夸克有十二个分量，轻子有四个。
Exactly thirty-six distinct monomials survive. This one has coefficient four.
恰好有三十六个互异单项留下来；这一项的系数是四。
So the same connection, clocks and mass spectrum allow any coefficient c6.
所以同一套联络、时钟与质量谱，可以配上任意的系数 c6。

scenes.name: NO LOCAL WALL
lines: Can local flatness forbid it? Lean checks, with zero axioms, that a closed two-cochain is exact.
局域平坦能不能禁止它？Lean 内核在零公理下检验：闭的二上链一定正合。
The proof is a cone: e of x, y is F of base, x, y, and d e gives back F.
证明就是一个锥：令 e(x, y) 等于 F(base, x, y)，它的上边缘恰好还原 F。
Lean also checks that six Hurwitz generators split mod five into nonzero rank-one matrices.
Lean 还检验：六个赫维茨生成元在模五下分裂为非零的秩一矩阵。
Neither fixes c6. Local closure builds no global wall; the proton needs a global symmetry.
这两条都管不住 c6。局域闭合砌不出全局的墙，质子需要一条全局对称。

scenes.name: BARYON TRIALITY
lines: Here is one. On neutral color singlets, the generation-universal charge reduces to minus h times B, mod three.
这就是一条：在超荷中性的色单态算符上，世代共同的荷化为负 h 乘 B，模三。
Take h nonzero. Yukawa couplings and the Weinberg term carry phase one. QQQL picks up a nontrivial cube root, and is forbidden.
取 h 不为零：汤川项与温伯格项相位为一，全部保留；QQQL 带上非平凡的三次单位根，被禁止。
Only changes of baryon number by three survive: the first allowed operator jumps from dimension six to fifteen.
只剩重子数改变三的过程，于是最低允许的算符从六维跳到十五维。
Keep B minus L too, and the floor is eighteen. Three generations of weak instantons change B by exactly three.
若同时守恒 B 减 L，门槛升到十八维；而三代弱瞬子恰好让 B 改变三。

scenes.name: SIX TRACES
lines: Triality can be gauged: X equals three B minus nine L tau, plus one conjugate tau neutrino.
重子三重对称可以规范化：X 等于三 B 减九 L_τ，再添一个共轭 τ 中微子。
All six anomaly traces, quarks against the tau family, cancel to zero.
六项反常迹，夸克对 τ 代，逐一相消为零。
A charge nine condensate leaves Z nine; its cube is the color center, so on color singlets it acts as Z three.
荷九凝聚留下 Z9；它的立方正是色中心，所以在色单态上作用为 Z3。
The price: the charge must depend on the generation.
代价是：荷必须依赖世代。

scenes.name: TWENTY-FIVE STATES
lines: Put the shell's own triality phase inside SU(5), on a lens space, and a cubic anomaly phase appears.
把球壳自己的三重相位装进 SU(5)，放到透镜空间上，就冒出一个立方反常相位。
The smallest extension that trivializes it is Z nine.
能把它平凡化的最小扩张是 Z9。
Carrying Z nine faithfully, the nineteen-point Behrend shell must grow to at least twenty-five states.
要忠实承载 Z9，十九点贝伦德球壳最少要扩到二十五个状态。

scenes.name: THE FORK
lines: The sharpest test: one actual Riemann zero, the joint witness, with its one hundred five winding vacuum.
最尖锐的检验是一枚实际的黎曼零点，即联合见证，以及它的一百零五圈真空。
Orthogonal auxiliary currents cancel the dimension-six vertex: triality holds, the proton is stable.
辅助电流相互正交，六维顶点相消，三重对称成立，质子稳定。
Parallel currents switch on QQQL, with a Wilson factor of at least zero point zero three one four.
辅助电流相互平行，QQQL 被激活，威尔逊因子至少约 0.0314。
The same vacuum allows both. Deciding c6 from the partition function is still open.
同一座真空两支都容许。从配分函数裁决 c6，仍是开放问题。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter nine.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第九章
